items.question: What is CurecordAI and how does it work?
items.answer: CurecordAI is an AI powered personal health record app for patients and families in Pakistan. You upload any medical document including prescriptions, lab reports, and discharge summaries. The AI reads the document, extracts medications, diagnoses, and lab results, and organizes everything in one searchable health vault per family member.

items.question: Is CurecordAI available on Android and iOS?
items.answer: Yes. CurecordAI is available as an Android app on Google Play, an iOS app on the Apple App Store, and as a website you can use in any browser.

items.question: Can I use CurecordAI on WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes. CurecordAI has a WhatsApp AI agent. You can upload documents and ask health questions directly through WhatsApp without downloading a separate app.

items.question: How is CurecordAI different from ChatGPT for health questions?
items.answer: ChatGPT can only give generic, population level answers because it has no access to your personal medical records. CurecordAI answers every question based on your own uploaded health history, so answers are specific to your actual diagnoses, medications, and lab results.

items.question: Can I manage records for my whole family?
items.answer: Yes. You can add family members such as your parents, spouse, and children to your account and keep each person's medical history organized separately under one family vault.

items.question: How do I share my records with a doctor?
items.answer: Open the Share with Doctor screen, choose what to share and for how long, and CurecordAI generates a secure QR code or link. The doctor scans it or opens the link to see your organized history instantly, with no account needed on their end.

items.question: What types of documents can I upload?
items.answer: You can upload prescriptions, medical reports, X-rays, and lab results. Each type is filed automatically into its own folder in your health vault.

items.question: Does CurecordAI support Urdu?
items.answer: Yes. The AI health assistant explains your medical documents in plain Urdu or English, so lab results and doctor's notes make sense in the language you're most comfortable with.

items.question: Is my health data private and secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your documents are stored securely and only accessible to you and the people you explicitly choose to share them with. CurecordAI never sells or exposes your health data to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.question: Is CurecordAI free to use?
items.answer: Yes, CurecordAI is completely free - including uploading records, the AI assistant, doctor sharing, and adding family members. There are no paid plans.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Last updated July 2026. This policy explains how CurecordAI collects, uses, and protects your information.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when you create an account, including your name, phone number or email, and profile details. We also store the medical documents you choose to upload, such as prescriptions, lab reports, and discharge summaries, along with any family member profiles you create.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to organize your uploaded documents, power the AI health assistant with answers based on your own records, and enable secure sharing with doctors you choose. We do not use your health data to train models for other users, and we do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: How your data is stored
sections.body: Documents are stored in encrypted cloud storage. Only a reference to each file is kept in our database - the file itself is served through short-lived, secure links generated on demand. Access to your account requires authentication, and sensitive actions are logged for security auditing.

sections.title: Sharing your records
sections.body: Your records are never visible to anyone unless you explicitly generate a share link or QR code from the Share with Doctor screen. You control what is shared and for how long, and you can revoke access at any time.

sections.title: Family member data
sections.body: When you add a family member profile, that person's records are managed under your account. You are responsible for having the appropriate authority to manage health information on their behalf, such as for a minor child or a dependent parent.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may access, update, or delete your account and associated data at any time from your Profile and Settings. You can also request a full export or deletion of your data by contacting our support team.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated through the app or by email before they take effect.

sections.title: Contact us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how your data is handled, contact us at support@curecordai.com.
